# Rutgers School of Arts and Sciences

> > The School of Arts and Sciences at Rutgers University–New Brunswick, offering liberal arts education, cutting-edge research, and public programs across sciences, humanities, and social sciences.

The School of Arts and Sciences is the academic heart of Rutgers University–New Brunswick, encompassing departments like Physics and Astronomy, specialized research centers including the W. M. Keck Center for spinal cord injury research, and public-facing institutions like the Rutgers Geology Museum. The school emphasizes student success, faculty research excellence, and community engagement through educational programs and cultural initiatives.

## Key Topics

- Liberal arts education
- Physics and Astronomy research
- Neuroscience and spinal cord injury
- Geology and natural history
- Student success initiatives
- Chemistry and genetics research
- Puerto Rico culture and studies
- Academic Master Plan
- Museum exhibits and public education
- Staff and student awards
- Gastrointestinal disease research
- Virtual educational programs
- Rutgers–New Brunswick campus

- [W. M. Keck Center for Collaborative Neuroscience](https://keck.sas.rutgers.edu/): W. M. Keck Center for spinal cord injury neuroscience research
